# Security policy

autocomplete sits between your keyboard and your shell, so security reports matter.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue. Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/KrisPowers/autocomplete/security/advisories/new) instead, with a description of the problem and steps to reproduce it. You can expect a reply within a week.

## Supported versions

Fixes go into the latest release.
